method: Source(Y,Z) triangle-ray cross-sections measure each finger's local X centre and thickness instead of flattening its full longitudinal X envelope. Fingers fold around the actual staff profile in a45degree mount basis so the shaft exits beside the palm rather than through wrist volume; thumb opposes the shaft. Anatomical thumb mask stops before the long index finger; distal thumb fairing and source-edge length constraints limit stretched tips. Welded-position groups move together across UV seams. Grip_R150 is new; original75/100 and all other frame deltas are copied exactly. Skin weights use the same prior smooth distal-hand correction. Requires actual3-view and animated approval; no numeric naturalness claim.
weightRule: Only original RightHand influence >=.5 and bind Y .025..19m. RightHand weight lerps to1 with smoothstep(Y=.025..065m); other original bone influences renormalize proportionally. Under .025m unchanged. v006 source, left hand, bind poses, UVs, base vertices and full-fist100 deltas preserved. Unarmed thumb skinning changes locally in v007 and must be visually rechecked.
swordMethod: New175 is derived from unchanged staff150: preserve axial position and pad thickness, subtract actual Staff-vs-Sword radial profile difference, then apply identical welded fairing/contact/edge constraints. Original75/100, staff150 and the skin weight formula are unchanged by adding175.
staffReadyPalmCompensation: Staff150 only: smooth local radial offset on palm sourceY .014..076, sourceZ below .040; maximum1.6mm. Compensates measured actual ready skin drift on450/449/425 and adjacent457/456/458 and1828/1831/1832. Sword175 and all weights unchanged.
swordWristCorrective: Disabled. The rejected30degree basis and strong16-vertex skin corrective were removed;45degree shaft placement is evaluated directly on original7101 topology.
swordWristRefinement: Disabled. Original7101 topology and index buffer restored; no additional vertices or midpoint skin corrections.
thumbWebSculpt: Grip150/175 only: CMC pivot moved from palmY.052 to basalY.017/Z.035. Anatomical thumb/web mask starts sourceZ.026..064 and permits a smooth basal rotation from sourceY.005..030, including original hand influence>=.30 in that thumb-only region. Ordinary wrist/weights unchanged. Palm-to-MCP curl blends over sourceY.025..055 instead of.040..070, avoiding stationary75 base connected to a rotated tip. Preserves transverse thumb volume with a rigid basal rotation and longitudinal scale; no additional contact iteration loops.
